About talent-share

A place to
learn and teach.

talent-share connects people who want to learn with people who have something to teach. The exchange happens live, online or in person.

Find something to learn↗

Learn directly from a provider

Learning with a provider gives you the chance to ask questions and work through something you do not understand. You can watch a demonstration and practise during a live session.

talent-share connects seekers with providers. Providers create programs around what they know. Seekers can read the details, choose a date, and attend a live session. Programs can take different forms, from a focused workshop or consultation to a program with several sessions.

Online and in-person programs

Online sessions run inside talent-share. In-person programs bring people into the same physical space. Both have a program page that holds the schedule, booking details, resources, and conversations.

Announcements, private messages, program discussions, and program files are available through the program. You can check for updates and find shared materials without searching through separate email threads.

Learn and teach with one account

You might teach a skill you know well and learn something completely new the following week. The same account supports both. Seekers can apply to teach, and approved providers can keep learning through their own enrolled programs.

You can use talent-share to learn, teach, or do both.
